conviction_note: This is a scheduled first-guide event: the FY27 outlook is due, the FY26 Q4 numbers have not been pre-released and there was no ad-hoc beforehand. Siemens' own compiled consensus (29 Oct) already sits above the top of the company's raised FY26 guide (EPS pre PPA 11.68 vs 11.20-11.50, Q4 2.93 vs an implied 2.45-2.75) and expects FY27 at 13.34 (+14%). The last first guide (Nov 2025) was conservative and the stock closed -9.35%, and the August 2026 beat-and-raise was sold (-4.49%). I take abs_move 6.0 from the European guidance-event base, scaled down for a mega-cap; that scale comes from the name's own FY-print moves of +4.9 and -9.35. p_up is 42: a lean resting on a sourced bar that sits above the company's own guide, pulled toward 50 because Siemens habitually beats its guides and peers (ABB, Schneider) are strong. expected = (0.84-1)*6.0 = -0.96. The findings sum to -2.2, larger than the scaled number, because each finding is sized alone.

findings.finding: Siemens' own compiled consensus has Q4 EPS pre PPA at EUR 2.93 and FY26 at 11.68. That is above the top of the company's raised FY26 guide of 11.20-11.50: with 9M at 8.75 the guide implies Q4 at 2.45-2.75, so the quarter has to beat Siemens' own top end by ~EUR 0.18 (~6%) just to meet the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26 (6 Aug 2026): record IB profit, beat helped by US tariff refunds, guide raised; close -4.49% (intraday more than -6%). BZ: 'Gewinnprognose hoch, Aktie runter'. This name sells beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus number itself is public, and that is the point: the market is holding a bar above the company's guidance. If the market thought a print inside the guide was the likely outcome, consensus would sit inside 11.20-11.50. It does not, so an at-guide print is not priced. Siemens' habit of beating its guides is the counterweight and is why this is small.
findings.independence: The boerse-global/ad-hoc-news preview (9 Nov) quotes the same Dow Jones-compiled 11.68 vs 11.20-11.50 gap: https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/unternehmensnachrichten/siemens-faces-a-high-bar-on-thursday-as-analysts-look-past-the-headline-year/70482983 (same underlying estimates, so not independent evidence about the outcome).

findings.finding: The first FY27 guide is due against a consensus of EUR 13.34 EPS pre PPA (+14% on 11.68), ex-SHL 10.68 on only 11 estimates. The last first guide (13 Nov 2025: 10.40-11.00) was conservative and was later raised twice to 11.20-11.50; the stock closed -9.35% that day. The two most recent sell-side previews expect at best an in-line outlook.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First-guide days: 13 Nov 2025 -9.35% (FY26 guide disappointed, Reuters: shares fell on 'next year's profit outlook'); 14 Nov 2024 +4.91%. Intra-year raises have been sold (6 Aug 2026 -4.49%).
findings.original_quote: RBC: 'Der Ausblick auf das Jahr 2027 dürfte den Konsensschätzungen eher kein neues Potenzial verleihen' (the 2027 outlook is unlikely to add new upside to consensus). JPMorgan, removing Siemens from its Analyst Focus List: 'Er rechnet mit einem Ausblick im Rahmen der Markterwartungen' (he expects an outlook in line with market expectations), https://www.finanzen.net/analyse/siemens_overweight-jp_morgan_chase_&_co._1119660
findings.why_not_priced: The previews are wire copy. What they do not price is Siemens' own guiding habit set against a consensus that assumes +14% EPS growth. If the market expected a conservative first guide, FY27 consensus would sit near a 'guide-style' number rather than at a level that already assumes the FY26 top end is beaten. The ex-SHL column is thin (11 estimates), so a guide given on that basis has no settled bar and the headline comparison is noisy.

findings.finding: Electrification peers that reported after Siemens' last print were very strong: ABB Q3 comparable orders +40% with data-centre orders up triple digits, and Schneider Q3 organic revenue +16.9% with its FY guide raised to 12-14%. That supports Smart Infrastructure beating its +23% comparable Q4 order consensus and guiding FY27 firmly.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At Q3 SI orders were +42% and SI guidance was raised, but the stock still fell -4.49% because peers had reported first (BZ: 'Das Abschneiden von Siemens kommt allerdings nicht ganz überraschend').
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: peer results are public and Deutsche Bank's preview already cites 'anhaltend starke Auftragsentwicklung in der Elektrifizierung' (a continuing strong order trend in electrification). It is a proxy, so small. Net of the rest of the company, SI is ~35% of IB profit consensus, and DI and SHL carry the risk.

findings.finding: Automation peers are softer than the DI consensus. Rockwell's fiscal Q4 sales were only +1% with slowing ARR, and its FY27 guide was a 'steady' 6-9% organic. Schneider's industrial automation grew +8.1% organically. Against that, the Siemens consensus wants DI FY27 margin at 20.5% (FY26 guide 17-19%) on +8% revenue, while expecting DI Q4 comparable orders of only +2%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: RBC names DI as the second focus after the outlook. In Nov 2025 the DI targets were read as strong (itiger Market Talk), yet the stock fell on the group profit guide.
findings.original_quote: Deutsche Bank (de-Bray): 'teils durchwachsene Geschäftszahlen der Konkurrenz im Automatisierungsgeschäft' (partly mixed business figures from competitors in automation)
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced (DB and Jefferies flag it). The unpriced part is the 20.5% DI FY27 margin in Siemens' own consensus sheet, roughly 150bp above the top of this year's DI guide range. A DI guide given as a range like 17-19% or 18-20% would read as below it. It is a proxy, so small, and DI is about 1/3 of IB profit.

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (median 9% on guidance events, hunters a factor of ~3 too small): abs_move_pct 5.5 -> 6.0 and the FY27 guidance finding -1.2 -> -1.5, sized on the guidance scale; the mega-cap's own first-guide moves (+4.9, -9.35) stopped it from going to 9.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': Healthineers finding -0.3 -> -0.1, because SHL's numbers have been public since 5 Nov.

'A beat made of a one-off is sold' (H&M tariff refund) and the name's own sold Q3 beat: no number changed, it reinforces keeping p_up at 42 rather than nearer 50, because a Q4 that reaches 2.93 on tariff refunds would not be paid.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': free cash flow added to new_in_release as unknown; no number changed.
